# Contributing to Akeeba Release System

Thank you for your interest in contributing! We welcome bug reports, feature
suggestions, documentation improvements, and pull requests from the community.

## Before you start

Please keep the following in mind:

- **This is primarily an internal project.** Akeeba Release System is developed
  and maintained mainly to serve our own company's use case. Our own
  requirements and priorities take precedence over external requests. We will
  do our best to be responsive and helpful, but a feature or change that
  doesn't align with our own use case may not be accepted, or may sit unreviewed
  for a long time.
- **Maintainers have the final say.** We appreciate every contribution, but
  the maintainers decide what gets merged, when, and how. Disagreement about
  scope, design, or implementation is normal and expected; the maintainers'
  decision on a given pull request or issue is final.
- **Open an issue before significant work.** For anything beyond a trivial
  fix (typos, small documentation tweaks), please open an issue first so we
  can discuss the approach before you invest time in a pull request that may
  not be merged.

## Reporting bugs

Use the Bug Report issue template and include enough detail (steps to
reproduce, versions, logs) for us to investigate.

## Suggesting features

Use the Feature Request issue template. Please explain the problem you're
trying to solve, not just the solution you have in mind — this helps us judge
whether it fits our use case.

## Submitting pull requests

- Reference the issue your pull request addresses (see the pull request
  template).
- Keep pull requests focused on a single change; unrelated changes should be
  split into separate pull requests.
- Follow the coding conventions and gotchas documented in `AGENTS.md` at the
  root of the repository.
- Make sure any relevant tests pass before submitting.

## Support

Please note that we do not provide user support through this repository — see
`SUPPORT.md`. Issues here are for bugs and feature requests only.

We appreciate your understanding and look forward to your contributions.
